title: Inadvertant intravenous injections
summary: Dr. John Campbell reviews a mouse study on accidental intravenous injection of an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine and its potential to cause myopericarditis. He walks through the methods and findings and discusses the aspiration technique.
why: HN uses it in vaccine-safety threads as a source on aspiration and the consequences of inadvertent intravenous injection, with mixed enthusiasm.
